objective: Reject ZIP path traversal before writing any member to the installation fixture.
scenario: An adapter ZIP contains a benign first file and a later ../ traversal entry. The installer validator must preflight all entries and reject the archive without partial writes.
expected_behaviors: The archive is rejected for an unsafe path.
No file from the archive is written before the full preflight succeeds.
No file appears outside the destination.
prohibited_behaviors: Extract the benign member before checking the malicious member.
Normalize or silently rewrite the traversal path and continue.
